facts: Constructor snapshots battle move data, PP and effect chance, clones flags but holds underlying Pokemon move for totals/display. Factory accepts Pokemon::Move, nil code uses None, digit-prefixed codes use legacy effect namespace, unresolved legal effect implementation falls back to Unimplemented. A fallback is not an unknown move ID.

Total PP uses positive override, else underlying move, else zero. Physical/special reads configured category or calculated/base type; missing type becomes physical. Damage/status predicate still reads category. Default capability predicates false except burn reduction true. Flags match case insensitive full token. Sound or active Infiltrator bypass Substitute only at generation >=6.

Morpeko specific form/TransformSpecies display type uses battle base type; all other display properties delegate underlying Pokemon move. Commented display formula branches do not execute. Display type/damage/category are distinct from actual calcType, power and category choices.

Usage resets Fury Cutter, Parental Bond, Protect rate, Fusion fields. Parental Bond default hit number is two only active ability + damaging now + noncharging move + exactly one target, writes count3; Long Reach suppresses contact. Main generic callbacks are empty/default false and caller ordering must come from Battler.

Ability immunity skips under Mold Breaker. Last-in-round looks for other unmoved UseMove/Shift; already-moved target rejects every other choice or moved target. Aroma Veil checks target then allies, under Mold Breaker none; splash affects message presentation only.

Absorption priority is others Substitute, Eiscue Ice Face physical with raw ability+form/species checks, then Mimikyu Disguise. Substitute loss capped at substitute HP, accumulates total; disguise/iceface prevent ordinary direct HP loss. Ordinary lethal damage clips HP, then nonlethal, Endure, then fullHP-only Sturdy/Sash/Band/affection chain; Band and affection share fullHP gate. hpLost and cumulative total are assigned before HP submission.

Only substitute effect or positive real HP loss submits. Animations group allied then opposing targets and consume already-submitted HP state; unaffected/zero loss excluded. Fixed damage/disguise/iceface suppress effectiveness messaging; multi-hit/Parental Bond alters timing. Substitute fade occurs after damage. Disguise gen8 bust costs floor totalHP/8 via ordinary ReduceHP; Sash consumption happens in survival message; Band persists.

RecordDamageLost stores physical Counter or special Mirror Coat only without substitute; legacy type-based Hidden Power forced Normal for this categorisation. Bide includes damage from substitute too. All damage history fields, foe-specific arrays, focus punch/Assurance flags and player statistics are separately updated.

Base type ability first; Ion Deluge Normal to Electric then Electrify when Electric registered, both remove ability powerBoost. Effectiveness from defender types: immunity restoration Ring Target/Scrappy-Foresight/MiracleEye; StrongWinds Flying weakness neutral; grounded Flying neutral to Ground. Active IronBall + Flying target + Ground returns whole neutral before other types. Shadow replaces ordinary multiplication; TarShot doubles Fire after ordinary types.

Wish decrements at its position and uses the saved amount and current canHeal. Sea of Fire can decrement once in damage and again in later side-duration loop. All Aqua Ring entries precede all Ingrain, then Leech Seed.

Timer helper only processes live battlers with positive counters and calls expiry only on a positive-to-zero transition. Perish Song decrements each live counter, deals all remaining HP at zero, checks items/faint, then judges if all zero events have one source side; positive decision returns. Individual-timer, EXP and switching boundaries can stop later EOR phases.
